newsitem.title: USA: U.S. W.Coast crude steady, ANS Jan trades at $1.65.
newsitem.headline: U.S. W.Coast crude steady, ANS Jan trades at $1.65.

text.p: U.S. West Coast crudes were generally firmer in line with West Texas Intermediate in the early session Monday, though regional differentials moved little in quiet trading.

BP and U.S. Oil agreed last Friday a trade in local benchmark Alaska North Slope (ANS) at a $1.65 discount to February WTI. Though a nickel above the previous reported deal, Friday's sal was for January delivery and traders disagreed about the direction of the February ANS price.
"I don't think it is a tightening market with all the turnarounds were seeing," said one major West Coast player.
